scope: Certify the exact Command Center runtime integration candidate in a real browser without modifying application, Blender, GLB, topology, content, or deployment state.
Build and launch the production preview locally from the exact candidate SHA.
Reuse the repository's existing browser certification patterns and pinned/transient Chromium or Playwright approach where practical.
Capture desktop, tablet-or-small-desktop, mobile, and forced non-WebGL evidence for /play?zone=command-center.

Verify the production GLB is actually requested successfully, retains the certified byte size/hash, and renders as Command Center scenery while React-owned movement, Ask, HUD and navigation remain functional.
Record page errors, console errors, failed requests, HTTP failures, viewport overflow, GLB request outcome, interaction checks, route-exit checks, and visual evidence.
Commit evidence only. Do not change runtime code in this task.
acceptance: Task executes from exact runtime candidate SHA 3998c4c774944baec9151111cc3f628b06fde029.
The production GLB remains byte-for-byte unchanged at SHA-256 72008b693cf0fc889aea7cf8af94ec2876cc0e3a7807b430e6e483fe275d7496 and 845512 bytes.
npm run verify passes before browser certification.
A production preview starts successfully and /api/health returns ok.
Desktop WebGL evidence is captured at 1440x1000 for /play?zone=command-center after the GLB finishes loading.
Additional responsive evidence is captured at 1024x768 and 390x844.
A forced non-WebGL path is exercised and the conventional fallback exposes working Projects, Resume, Ask and Contact navigation.
Browser evidence records zero application page errors, zero unexpected console errors, zero failed asset/API requests, and zero unexpected HTTP failures on the certified Command Center path.
The browser requests /world/art/command-center.glb successfully and the response byte length is consistent with the certified asset.
The Command Center visually reads as the certified floating civic hub rather than the old procedural grid/hologram scene.
The player/avatar, HUD, Ask station, movement target feedback and world navigation remain visually and functionally legible over the authored scenery.
The authored GLB does not visually obscure the player spawn, Ask interaction area, bridge entrances, HUD, or essential movement/readability cues.
No obvious z-fighting, exploded transforms, missing materials, black/magenta asset failure, gross clipping, or severe camera/scenery mismatch is visible.
At 390x844, the world HUD/map controls remain usable and the viewport has no horizontal overflow.
Ask Terminal interaction reaches the existing Ask flow or opens its interaction overlay without runtime failure.
At least one SPA exit from /play to a conventional route completes with zero page errors and no failed requests.
Evidence includes browser-evidence.json, desktop.png, 1024.png, mobile-390.png, fallback.png or fallback evidence, and runtime-certification.md.
blender-assets, runtime-integration and icm-stage validations pass on the unchanged candidate/evidence commit.
Independent Terra review of the exact screenshots/logs returns pass with no required fixes.
No application code, GLB, Blender source, feature branch, main, or deployment change occurs.
stop_conditions: The certified runtime candidate ref no longer resolves to 3998c4c774944baec9151111cc3f628b06fde029.
The production GLB hash or size differs from the certified values.
The GLB request fails, returns a non-success status, or the asset does not render.
A browser/page/runtime error appears that cannot be explained as a known harmless headless-browser environment warning.
The authored scene materially obscures spawn, Ask, bridge entrances, movement readability, or HUD.
The visual result materially diverges from the certified Blender detailed renders or appears broken after integration.
Fixing a discovered issue would require any protected application or asset path change; in that case preserve evidence and STOP so a separate correction task can be created.
Independent Terra review returns fix_required or stop.
